messages:
From: Tim Garcia <tim.garcia@healthcloud.io>

Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@healthcloud.io>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Keystore + Audit log pricing for pilot

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the demo earlier — team was impressed with the latency and the prefix-caching behavior. Procurement asked me to get a clearer picture on the incremental costs for the compliance stack so we can budget the pilot. Quick questions:

- For a 12-month pilot (estimated 500k tokens / month), what is the delta between managed KMS vs a dedicated HSM seat?
- If we choose US-only residency, is there an additional recurring charge or just the HSM/KMS line item?
- Audit logs: our security team wants 3 months of hot retention and 1 year cold; can you provide a ballpark uplift in $/month for that profile and whether you bill per-GB or as a package?
- Any room on add-on pricing if we commit to the 12-month pilot and agree to expand to production in 6–9 months?

Procurement (procurement@healthcloud.io) is copied — they’ll send PO details if we can agree on the numbers.

Thanks,
Tim
Tim Garcia
Head of Platform Security, HealthCloud
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
To: Tim Garcia <tim.garcia@healthcloud.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Keystore + Audit log pricing for pilot

Hi Tim — great to hear and thanks for the clear list. I put together two pragmatic pricing pathways below that we typically offer for pilots like this (summary attached). I copied Marissa & Jonas for visibility on commercial/legal routing.

Option A — Managed KMS (lower footprint)
- Managed KMS: $1.2k/month flat for key management and request throughput typical at this scale
- Residency (US-only): no additional flat surcharge beyond a small regional egress/replication premium (~$400/mo) for auditlog replication to a US-only bucket
- Audit logs (3mo hot / 1yr cold): $650/mo (bundled rate, covered as a retention package billed monthly)

Option B — Dedicated HSM seat + on-prem-style guardrails (higher assurance)
- HSM seat (dedicated logical partition): $7k/month (includes key attestations & 24/7 monitoring)
- Residency: $0 extra besides HSM seat; we keep keys and attestations in the US partition
- Audit logs (same retention): $650/mo

Pilot concession (what I can commit to today):
- If HealthCloud signs a 12-month commit and includes a production rollout target within 9 months, Redwood can apply a one-time pilot discount on compliance add-ons: 30% off managed KMS / 20% off HSM seat for the first 3 billing months.
- Additionally, we can offer a $10k onboarding credit that offsets the implementation SOW (applied upon PO).

I attached a short pricing scenario PDF that breaks this into monthly/annual numbers and a draft SOW. If Procurement wants this as a formal redlineable quote, Jonas can loop in legal and Marissa can land the commercial terms.

Attached: [attachment: keystore-pricing-scenario.pdf (PDF)]

Best,
Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.example>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Keystore + Audit log pricing for pilot — proposed concession ask

Marissa / Jonas / Priyom — forwarding Tim’s ask and my initial reply. Summary of the commercial question: HealthCloud wants to know how much we can concede on the compliance add-ons if they commit to a 12-month pilot with a production target ~Q3 2027. They are sensitive to both the HSM seat cost and audit-log uplift.

Proposal I think is reasonable and preserves unit economics:
- Pilot discount: 25–30% on managed KMS, 15–20% on HSM seat for first 3 months, with a $10k onboarding credit (applied as a one-time invoice credit). Preference is to front-load concession to shorten friction on PO.
- Audit log: keep as packaged retention fee ($650/mo) but allow 50% off the first month to cover ingestion spikes.
- Approvals: I need greenlight to offer up to 30% on KMS and $10k credit. Anything above that requires CRO approval.

Questions for finance/legal:
- Priyom — is $10k onboarding credit acceptable as a non-refundable offset? Should we tie it to a minimum ARR threshold for production rollout?
- Jonas — any red flags on committing to production window language in the quote?

Attachments: keystore-pricing-scenario.pdf (sent to customer)

Thanks — will try to keep the language tight in the commercial quote if you approve.

—Ben
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
To: Tim Garcia <tim.garcia@healthcloud.io>, Procurement Team <procurement@healthcloud.io>

Subject: Re: Keystore + Audit log pricing for pilot — formal offer

Hi Tim / Procurement — following internal confirmation, please find the commercial pathway we can offer for the pilot. I’ll attach the draft SOW and a DocuSign envelope for signatures once you confirm the path.

Final pilot offer (valid 30 days):
- Managed KMS path (recommended for pilot): $840/month (30% pilot discount applied for months 1–3), then $1,200/mo thereafter.
- Dedicated HSM path: $5,600/month (20% discount applied for months 1–3), then $7,000/mo thereafter.
- Residency: US-only — no additional flat residency surcharge beyond the small replication premium included in the auditlog line.
- Audit logs: bundled retention package (3mo hot / 1yr cold) — $650/mo; we will apply a 50% credit for month 1 to cover ingestion and proofing, then full price thereafter.
- One-time onboarding credit: $10,000 applied as credit on first invoice upon PO.

Commercial conditions:
- Offer requires a 12-month pilot commitment (PO to be issued within 14 days of signed quote) and a statement of intent to target production deployment within 9 months. The production-deployment clause will be non-binding commercial guidance (no automatic price step-ups), only used to qualify the pilot concession.
- We will provide standard SOC2 evidence package and an HSM attestation snapshot during onboarding.

Next steps:
1) If this looks good, confirm which path (KMS vs HSM) you prefer and I’ll send the formal quote + SOW.
2) Procurement can send PO to orders@redwood.example.

Attachments: [attachment: SOW-HC-pilot-draft.docx (DOCX)]
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/placeholder-hc-docusign

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-minute call to walk through the SOW details.

Best,
